PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Detail-oriented Network Engineer with 4 years of hands-on experience across rouNng, switching, wireless, ﬁrewall, and automaNon in large-scale enterprise environments. Skilled at debugging complex network issues across OSI Layers, collaboraNng with engineering teams, and driving operaNonal excellence. raw_sections.skills:
KEY SKILLS
Routing & Switching
Advanced knowledge of routing protocols: BGP, OSPF, IS-IS Layer 2/Layer 3 technologies: VLANs, STP/RSTP, LACP, VRRP • • Understanding of SD-WAN fundamentals and architectures • Experience with path selection, and convergence troubleshooting
Cloud Networking (AWS)
Hands-on experience with AWS VPC, Subnets, Route Tables, Internet/NAT Gateways • Knowledge of AWS Transit Gateway and hybrid connectivity models • Security constructs: Security Groups, Network ACLs • Familiarity with VPC peering, routing design, and traffic flow analysis
Networking Protocols & Technologies
Strong foundation in TCP/IP stack, Ethernet, ARP, DNS, DHCP • Deep understanding of packet forwarding, MTU, and fragmentation • Experience with IPsec VPN (site-to-site concepts, encryption basics) • Knowledge of IP tunneling (GRE, encapsulation, overlay networks)
Network Automation & Programming
Proficient in Python for network automation, scripting, and troubleshooting • Experience working with REST APIs for network/service integration • Familiar with data formats: JSON, XML • Basic exposure to automation workflows and infrastructure-as-code concepts
Monitoring, Troubleshooting & Operations
Experience in network monitoring, telemetry, and alerting systems • Strong troubleshooting skills using logs, packet analysis, and debugging tools • Knowledge of incident management, root cause analysis (RCA) • Understanding of change management and production network operations
Collaboration & Problem Solving
Effective collaboration with cross-functional teams (network, cloud, security, application)
Strong analytical skills to debug complex, ambiguous network issues • Ability to design scalable and reliable network solutions • Clear and concise technical communication and documentation skills
